output.question: Has Paramount announced layoffs?

passages.quote: We have stepped back and taken some time to consider where we are investing our efforts and have made the difficult decision to scale down some of our projects. As a result, there are roles impacted.
Paramount Games Studio was created last summer by the merger of Skydance and Paramount gaming businesses and that in turn became Skydance Games after the merger with WBD closed Oct. 6.

output.answer: Yes. On November 9, 2026, a company spokesperson confirmed layoffs in Skydance Games, which incorporates the former Paramount Games Studio, as projects are scaled down and operations reorganized. Paramount was renamed Skydance following completion of its Warner Bros. Discovery acquisition on October 6, 2026. The latest announcement did not specify how many roles were affected or which projects were being reduced.
caveats: The latest confirmed cuts described here concern gaming operations; this announcement does not establish a company-wide layoff total.
missing_fields: Official headcount and affected project names for the November gaming layoffs.

key_facts.fact: A company spokesperson confirmed that reorganization and scaling down projects at Skydance Games affected employee roles.
Paramount Games Studio became part of Skydance Games following the Warner Bros. Discovery merger.
The number of affected roles and the projects being scaled back were not disclosed in the report.
Paramount completed its Warner Bros. Discovery acquisition, creating the combined company named Skydance.
